title: Vercel Functions on Fluid compute switched to Active CPU pricing
detail: CPU is billed at $0.128 per hour only while code is actively executing, with provisioned memory at $0.0106 per GB-hour. A Standard machine at full CPU moves from about $0.31842 per hour to about $0.149 per hour.
impact: A genuine decrease for anything that waits on a model call. Long-running agents and LLM inference stop paying full rate while blocked on I/O.
